name: Octave
description: The pitch of a ruling doubling across the sheet, an octave from edge to edge.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 @calc(20 - 15 * @x / @X)%, transparent 0 @calc(40 - 30 * @x / @X)%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 @calc(20 - 15 * @x / @X)%, transparent 0 @calc(40 - 30 * @x / @X)%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
